newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu back home this month, premier says.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu back home this month, premier says.

text.p: Zaire's prime minister said on Thursday that President Mobutu Sese Seko would be back home from surgery and convalescence in Europe before the end of the month.
"He himself has said that he will have a medical checkup on the 25th of November, and will return home three days later," Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo told a news conference.

Kengo last week met Mobutu at the president's villa in the south of France where he is recovering from cancer surgery. During his absence, Zaire has suffered a rebellion in its east which has caused a refugee crisis.
Mobutu underwent more than two months of treatment for prostate cancer in Lausanne, Switzerland before leaving on November 4 for the French Riviera.
The Zairean ruler had said he intended to return to Lausanne for a medical check-up but Switzerland has denied him a visa after his presence sparked protests.
Appearing in a CNN interview shown on Thursday, the 66-year-old Mobutu looked thinner but healthy and alert.
